list.name: image
list.label: Image
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT requested_image FROM pipeline_runs ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::bigint AS value FROM pipeline_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR requested_image = '$image')

SELECT COALESCE(sum(sr.critical_count + sr.high_count + sr.medium_count + sr.low_count + sr.unknown_count), 0)::bigint AS value FROM scan_runs sr JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = sr.pipeline_id WHERE sr.phase = 'original' AND sr.status = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image')

SELECT COALESCE(sum(sd.fixed_count), 0)::bigint AS value FROM scan_diffs sd JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = sd.pipeline_id WHERE $__timeFilter(sd.created_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image')

SELECT COALESCE(sum(sd.remaining_count), 0)::bigint AS value FROM scan_diffs sd JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = sd.pipeline_id WHERE $__timeFilter(sd.created_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image')

SELECT COALESCE(sum(sd.introduced_count), 0)::bigint AS value FROM scan_diffs sd JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = sd.pipeline_id WHERE $__timeFilter(sd.created_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image')

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, '1d'), status AS metric, count(*)::bigint AS value FROM pipeline_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR requested_image = '$image') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT sr.phase AS "Phase", COALESCE(sum(sr.critical_count),0)::bigint AS "Critical", COALESCE(sum(sr.high_count),0)::bigint AS "High", COALESCE(sum(sr.medium_count),0)::bigint AS "Medium", COALESCE(sum(sr.low_count),0)::bigint AS "Low", COALESCE(sum(sr.unknown_count),0)::bigint AS "Unknown" FROM scan_runs sr LEFT JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = sr.pipeline_id WHERE sr.status = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image') GROUP BY sr.phase ORDER BY sr.phase

WITH original_scan AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pipeline_id) * FROM scan_runs WHERE phase = 'original' ORDER BY pipeline_id, started_at DESC), patched_scan AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pipeline_id) * FROM scan_runs WHERE phase = 'patched' ORDER BY pipeline_id, started_at DESC), latest_patch AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pipeline_id) * FROM patch_runs ORDER BY pipeline_id, started_at DESC), latest_diff AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pipeline_id) * FROM scan_diffs ORDER BY pipeline_id, created_at DESC) SELECT pr.started_at AS "Started", pr.requested_image AS "Image", CASE WHEN pr.requested_image ~ ':[^/]+$' THEN regexp_replace(pr.requested_image, '^.*:', '') ELSE 'latest' END AS "Version", pr.status AS "Pipeline Status", COALESCE(os.critical_count,0) AS "Original Critical", COALESCE(os.high_count,0) AS "Original High", COALESCE(os.medium_count,0) AS "Original Medium", COALESCE(os.low_count,0) AS "Original Low", COALESCE(ps.critical_count + ps.high_count + ps.medium_count + ps.low_count + ps.unknown_count,0) AS "Patched Total", COALESCE(ld.fixed_count,0) AS "Fixed", COALESCE(ld.remaining_count,0) AS "Remaining", COALESCE(ld.introduced_count,0) AS "Introduced", lp.status AS "Copa Status", lp.patched_image_ref AS "Patched Image" FROM pipeline_runs pr LEFT JOIN original_scan os ON os.pipeline_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN patched_scan ps ON ps.pipeline_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN latest_patch lp ON lp.pipeline_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN latest_diff ld ON ld.pipeline_id = pr.id WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.started_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image') ORDER BY pr.started_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT pr.requested_image AS "Image", COALESCE(sum(sd.fixed_count),0)::bigint AS "Fixed", COALESCE(sum(sd.remaining_count),0)::bigint AS "Remaining", COALESCE(sum(sd.introduced_count),0)::bigint AS "Introduced" FROM scan_diffs sd JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = sd.pipeline_id WHERE $__timeFilter(sd.created_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image') GROUP BY pr.requested_image ORDER BY "Fixed" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT pa.status AS metric, count(*)::bigint AS value FROM patch_runs pa JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = pa.pipeline_id WHERE $__timeFilter(pa.started_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image') GROUP BY pa.status ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT pol.status AS metric, count(*)::bigint AS value FROM policy_results pol JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = pol.pipeline_id WHERE $__timeFilter(pol.created_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image') GROUP BY pol.status ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT sr.started_at AS "Scan Time", sr.phase AS "Phase", sr.image_ref AS "Scanned Image", CASE WHEN sr.image_ref ~ ':[^/]+$' THEN regexp_replace(sr.image_ref, '^.*:', '') ELSE 'latest' END AS "Version", v.severity AS "Severity", v.vulnerability_id AS "Vulnerability", v.pkg_name AS "Package", v.installed_version AS "Installed", v.fixed_version AS "Fixed Version", v.title AS "Title", v.primary_url AS "URL" FROM vulnerabilities v JOIN scan_runs sr ON sr.id = v.scan_id LEFT JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = sr.pipeline_id WHERE $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image') ORDER BY CASE v.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, sr.started_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT v.pkg_name AS "Package", v.severity AS "Severity", count(*)::bigint AS "Findings", max(v.fixed_version) AS "Latest Fixed Version" FROM vulnerabilities v JOIN scan_runs sr ON sr.id = v.scan_id LEFT JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = sr.pipeline_id WHERE $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image') GROUP BY v.pkg_name, v.severity ORDER BY "Findings" DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT pa.started_at AS "Started", pa.finished_at AS "Finished", pr.requested_image AS "Source Image", pa.source_image_ref AS "Copa Source", pa.patched_image_ref AS "Patched Image", pa.status AS "Status", pa.error_message AS "Error" FROM patch_runs pa JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = pa.pipeline_id WHERE $__timeFilter(pa.started_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image') ORDER BY pa.started_at DESC LIMIT 100

WITH latest_reports AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (gr.resource_id) gr.id, gr.resource_id, gr.created_at FROM generated_reports gr JOIN pipeline_runs pr_filter ON pr_filter.id::text = gr.resource_id WHERE gr.resource_type = 'pipeline' AND gr.format = 'html' AND pr_filter.status IN ('success','policy_failed','failed') ORDER BY gr.resource_id, gr.created_at DESC), original_scan AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pipeline_id) * FROM scan_runs WHERE phase = 'original' ORDER BY pipeline_id, started_at DESC), patched_scan AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pipeline_id) * FROM scan_runs WHERE phase = 'patched' ORDER BY pipeline_id, started_at DESC), latest_diff AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pipeline_id) * FROM scan_diffs ORDER BY pipeline_id, created_at DESC) SELECT lr.created_at AS "Created", pr.requested_image AS "Image", CASE WHEN pr.requested_image ~ ':[^/]+$' THEN regexp_replace(pr.requested_image, '^.*:', '') ELSE 'latest' END AS "Version", pr.status AS "Pipeline Status", COALESCE(os.critical_count + os.high_count + os.medium_count + os.low_count + os.unknown_count, 0) AS "Original Total", COALESCE(ps.critical_count + ps.high_count + ps.medium_count + ps.low_count + ps.unknown_count, 0) AS "Patched Total", COALESCE(ld.fixed_count,0) AS "Fixed", COALESCE(ld.remaining_count,0) AS "Remaining", COALESCE(ld.introduced_count,0) AS "Introduced", '/appsec-api/api/reports/' || lr.id || '/download' AS "Download" FROM latest_reports lr JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id::text = lr.resource_id LEFT JOIN original_scan os ON os.pipeline_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN patched_scan ps ON ps.pipeline_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN latest_diff ld ON ld.pipeline_id = pr.id WHERE $__timeFilter(lr.created_at) AND ('$image' = 'All' OR pr.requested_image = '$image') ORDER BY lr.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
